title.narrative: Afghanistan Food Security and Emergency Project 2024

description.narrative: - Securing and distributing food baskets to the poor, needy and orphans among returnees and those affected by natural disasters in Afghanistan. - Contributing to decent living by securing and distributing approximately 60,000 food baskets. - Achieving the goal of alleviating the suffering of the vulnerable community of returnees and those affected by natural disasters in their daily lives.
Distributing food supplies to returnees from neighboring countries Pakistan, Iran and victims of natural disasters who only get a little food to continue their daily lives.
Raising and enhancing food security by distributing food baskets to the needy and most needy families in Afghanistan.
